runs.text: This book does not provide guidance, advice, or solutions.
It is a psychological and philosophical reflection of human thought patterns, perception, and internal observation.
The content may feel personal at times, but it is not directed toward any individual or specific experience.
The ideas presented here are not absolute truths.
They are interpretations of how awareness, thinking, and self-observation can alter human experience.
Reading this book may cause increased self-reflection.
That reflection is not controlled by the author and varies from person to person.
The author is not responsible for any emotional interpretation, discomfort, or realization that may arise from reading this material.
